subject.title: Feature Request: Add cumulative history search and multi-account support

question: Should wacrawl adopt a cumulative per-account archive, or remain a point-in-time mirror with a separate cross-snapshot search layer?
rationale: The choice determines deletion semantics, deduplication identity, migration behavior, storage cost, and compatibility with the existing backup and restore contract.

options.title: Cumulative per-account archive
options.body: Reconcile each import into an account-scoped historical archive while retaining Git commits as point-in-time backup snapshots.

options.title: Snapshot federation
options.body: Keep replacement imports and build a query or indexing layer over selected historical backup commits.

options.title: Defer first-class support
options.body: Continue using separate source, database, and backup configuration paths and document that manual isolation workflow.

recommendation.title: Cumulative per-account archive
recommendation.body: Reconcile each import into an account-scoped historical archive while retaining Git commits as point-in-time backup snapshots.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged snapshot and media-backup work defines the current restore contract that this product decision would revise.
